messages:
priya: Heads up — since ~09:12 UTC we've seen mTLS handshake errors across ap-south services after yesterday's RBAC prune. Errors show "keystore: unwrap denied" on ingress proxies. Anyone else?

darren: saw it. spike in 5xx on ap-south ingest. correlating with cert refresh job. digging.

sara: confirmed logs: proxy -> keystore service 403 on /decrypt/unwrapped. sample log id: f2c4e8. KMS returns AccessDenied for key alias "keystore-unwrap-prod". Notable: audit logs don't show a corresponding key:Decrypt event for that request.

alex: that's odd — can you paste log snippet?

sara: 
```
2026-03-22T09:12:34Z proxy-127.0.0.1 INFO handshake failed err=keystore: unwrap denied key=alias/keystore-unwrap-prod req_id=f2c4e8 service=ingress-proxy
kms_resp: AccessDenied: User arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/keystore-accessor is not authorized to perform kms:Decrypt
```

priya: we rolled out RBAC change "keystore-reader" -> "keystore-accessor" yesterday to tighten perms. It should still allow kms:Decrypt. Looks like the keystore service is assuming role A but the KMS policy might still reference role B.

darren: also saw keystore-shadow entries in DB (old_key_id present) — projection/rotation may not have cleaned up.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: Canaries for rbacs/keystore-prune finished at 2026-03-22T02:00Z. No automated rollback triggered.

oncall: tagging SRE — @sre-team please triage, this is causing live user impact for ap-south.

alex: immediate mitigation: revert RBAC change for keystore-prune or attach kms:Decrypt to the new role. Which is faster depends on approval.

sara: KMS console shows last successful decrypt for alias occurred at 2026-03-22T01:45Z. After that, new role's ARNs don't appear in key policy. Key policy contains explicit principal list; ACL update failed in last infra patch.

darren: hypothesis: policy update job had a race with IAM role rename. Key policy still references role ARN that no longer exists, so KMS denies; audit logs don't show because request principal unresolved.

priya: action plan:
- (P0) revert RBAC role rename (darren) — ETA 15m
- (P0) add keystore-accessor to KMS key policy (sara) — ETA 30m
- collect all failing req_ids and correlate with proxies (alex) — ETA 45m
- run a canary decrypt from ap-south (priya) — ETA 10m
- after fix, run full cert refresh backfill and monitor 2h (oncall)

darren: starting revert now: iamctl undo role/keystore-accessor-rename --dry-run=false

sara: patching KMS key policy: adding principal arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/keystore-accessor
```json
{"Statement":"Allow","Principal":"arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/keystore-accessor","Action":"kms:Decrypt"}
```

infra-bot: iamctl: role rename reverted successfully at 2026-03-22T09:28:12Z

sara: KMS policy updated, waiting 60s for policy propagation.

alex: running canary decrypt now: 
```
curl -X POST https://keystore.ap-south.internal/decrypt -d '{"key":"alias/keystore-unwrap-prod","cipher":"..."}' -H "x-req-id: canary-01"
```

sara: canary succeeded req_id=canary-01 status=200 decrypt_ms=34

oncall: rolling cert refresh queued for impacted tenants. will watch error rate.

priya: will also file an incident ticket and link this thread. Need postmortem: why did policy-update job not include new role? add test coverage to catch key-policy drift.

darren: collecting req_ids: [f2c4e8, a7b1c2, d9ef00] (will upload logs to S3: s3://redwood-incident/ap-south/keystore-unwrap/)

sara: observed audit gap: CloudTrail shows no kms:Decrypt entries for the denied reqs. reaching out to cloud infra for missing audit delivery.

alex: follow-ups:
- add cross-check in RBAC rename playbook: run KMS keypolicy diff for affected keys before prune
- add "keystore-policy smoke" step in deploy pipeline
- create alert: if keystore service returns >1% unwrap_denied over 5m, open paged alert.

priya: ok good work. anyone object to leaving temporary keystore-reader principal in key policy for 48h to avoid reoccurance? if no objections I'll leave it.

darren: fine.

oncall: fine.

sara: filing PRs for the playbook changes now. I'll also add an audit query to detect principals referenced in role->policy vs keypolicy.

priya: thanks everyone. Postmortem owner: priya. SLA hit: brief 12m spike; customers affected: ingest ap-south. I'll start the incident doc.
